data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin to implement a liquid swipe effect to provided widgets.
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget that lets users swipe between stacked pages using a liquid reveal transition animation. Includes controller support for programmatic page navigation and various customization options like loop control and wave types.
use_when: You are building an onboarding flow and want a unique liquid swipe effect
You want to transition between pages with a custom wave clipper animation
avoid_when: You need a standard horizontal page slider or tab view without custom physics
Performance on lower-end devices is a critical concern for heavy custom clippers
strengths: Easy integration with standard widgets and containers
Provides a LiquidController for programmatic navigation
weaknesses: Limited to a specific swipe and reveal animation effect
Can be frequent on swipe callbacks which require careful handling
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import the package.
